ParameterTarget.role: The native integral conversion of an explicitly cast projected marker.
ParameterTarget.structure: A closed SIGNED or UNSIGNED choice retained with the one-based parameter position.
ParameterTarget.conditions: The marker occupies a projected scalar CAST. The owning SELECT enforces its lexical position independently of signedness. Compound arms own separate scopes and place their markers in emitted lexical order.
ParameterTarget.meaning: Execute the selected native signed or unsigned BIGINT conversion of the supplied marker. A NULL input yields NULL. The selected cast contributes to the enclosing native compound result type.
ParameterTarget.sql: Render CAST(? AS SIGNED) or CAST(? AS UNSIGNED) from the retained target. The optional written INTEGER suffix does not change the target.

counterexamples.sql: SELECT CAST(? AS UNSIGNED) AS a0
counterexamples.resolution: Preserve the exact input and observe it as a valid unsigned marker. The independently justified refusal remains for cast targets outside this integer role.
Preserve this exact unaliased input and its native heading. Test an unsupported position of the marker inside a second cast separately.

finite.recovery: Measure the profile identifier and both projected target or slot nodes. Reconcile the externally supplied binding vector and exact output labels and types. Require one observation of every independently expanded coordinate.

semanticRule: For the fixed signed INT64 wire inputs, the UNSIGNED cast interprets the integer as its unsigned 64-bit representation. MYSQL 5.6 and 5.7 use the ordered native signedness of the participating first arm for mixed signedness in this compound domain. Conversion to a signed result saturates a positive unsigned value above INT64_MAX. Conversion to an unsigned result saturates a negative signed value to zero. Newer MySQL releases select the native decimal type for the mixed signedness cases. The observer keeps its native value representation including numbers beyond PHP_INT_MAX.

obligations.Q02: Check exact historical inputs and all declared direct coordinates in both modes, with independent generated values.
obligations.Q03: Retain both marker and native result conversion at a checked compound boundary.
